definition.name: Ferrule crimper
definition.description: Compress a correctly sized ferrule around a prepared stranded conductor.

parts.name: Crimper grips
parts.purpose: Closing the grips drives the crimping die.

parts.name: Crimping dies
parts.purpose: The dies compress the metal sleeve around the prepared conductor.

parts.name: Ratchet and pivot
parts.purpose: A ratcheting mechanism controls the crimp stroke. The sample checks ferrule size.
